api_changes: Opt-in Recipe.optimizer_smoothing and NormalizedOptimizer(smoothing=...), default zero; positive scales bound in optimizer checkpoints
changed_factors: Recipe.optimizer_smoothing=0.0001 for every player and update
Retain the incumbent BCAP DualNorm global rates G/E=.012,D=.018,prior=.03
mechanism_rationale: Opt in to fixed-scale smoothed DualNorm while retaining numerical-rank truncation, BCAP, constant rates, zero momentum, and all task-owned laws. Matrix singular weights are s/hypot(s,lambda); nonmatrix network directions and actually sampled prior rows use g/hypot(norm(g),lambda). The vector rules are an explicit adaptation. One positive global lambda is a reusable structural control, not a qualification or default adoption.
